_provenance.notes: Pacific Halibut (Hippoglossus stenolepis) is managed by the International Pacific Halibut Commission (IPHC) under the 1979 Pacific Halibut Convention. The IPHC sets coastwide Catch Per Unit Effort (CPUE) based Fishery Independent Setline Survey (FISS) biomass indices each January at the IPHC Annual Meeting. Alaska commercial halibut IFQ permits are among the most expensive in the world — Area 3A permits (Central GOA) trade at $60-$85 per IFQ pound.

ifq_market_2024.notes: Halibut IFQ is transferable and leaseable; lease rates in 3A averaged $2.80/lb in 2024
